description_en: Query the list of identity providers
name: ListIdentityProviders

parameters.help_en: The direction of the identity provider
parameters.name: direction

AdvancedStatus.description_en:
Whether the advanced configuration is enabled. Valid values:

Disabled: disabled

Enabled: enabled
AdvancedStatus.description_zh:
是否开启高阶配置能力，取值范围：

禁用：disabled

启用：enabled

AuthnSourceSupplier.description_en:
The authentication source product, such as Okta, Google, or Azure AD.
Valid values:

DingTalk: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:alibaba:dingtalk

LDAP: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:unknown:ldap

Alibaba Cloud IDaaS: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:alibaba:idaas

WeCom: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:tencent:wecom

Lark: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:bytedance:lark

Active Directory: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:microsoft:ad

Azure Active Directory: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:microsoft:aad

Alibaba Cloud SASE: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:alibaba:sase

AuthnSourceType.description_en:
The authentication source type, OIDC or SAML. Valid values:

OIDC: urn:alibaba:idaas:authntype:oidc

SAML: urn:alibaba:idaas:authntype:saml2
AuthnSourceType.description_zh:
认证方式类型 oidc or saml，取值范围：

OIDC：urn:alibaba:idaas:authntype:oidc

SAML：urn:alibaba:idaas:authntype:saml2
AuthnSourceType.title_en: 认证方式类型 oidc or saml
AuthnSourceType.title_zh: 认证方式类型 oidc or saml

AuthnStatus.description_en:
Whether the corresponding IdP supports authentication. Valid values:

Disabled: disabled

Enabled: enabled
AuthnStatus.description_zh:
对应IdP是否支持认证，取值范围：

禁用：disabled

启用：enabled

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time, in Unix timestamp format, measured in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

IdentityProviderExternalId.description_en: External ID of the identity provider

IdentityProviderType.description_en:
The synchronization type of the identity provider.

Inbound DingTalk: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:alibaba:dingtalk:pull

Outbound DingTalk: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:alibaba:dingtalk:push

Inbound WeCom: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:tencent:wecom:pull

Inbound Lark: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:bytedance:lark:pull

Inbound AD: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:microsoft:ad:pull

Inbound LDAP: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:unknown:ldap:pull

Standard OIDC: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:standard:oidc

SASE Customized OIDC: urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:alibaba:sase
IdentityProviderType.description_zh:
身份提供方同步类型。

出方向钉钉：urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:alibaba:dingtalk:push

入方向企业微信：urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:tencent:wecom:pull

入方向飞书：urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:bytedance:lark:pull

入方向AD：urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:microsoft:ad:pull

入方向LDAP：urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:unknown:ldap:pull

标准OIDC：urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:standard:oidc

SASE定制OIDC：urn:alibaba:idaas:idp:alibaba:sase

IncrementalCallbackStatus.description_en:
The incremental callback status, indicating whether incremental callback data from the IdP is processed. Valid values:

Disabled: disabled

Enabled: enabled
IncrementalCallbackStatus.description_zh:
增量回调状态，是否处理来自IdP的增量回调数据，取值范围：

禁用：disabled

启用：enabled
IncrementalCallbackStatus.title_en: 增量回调状态，是否处理来自IdP的增量回调数据
IncrementalCallbackStatus.title_zh: 增量回调状态，是否处理来自IdP的增量回调数据

LastStatusCheckJobResult.description_en: The last status check result. Before synchronization, a sync task can only be triggered when the identity provider status check result is success
LastStatusCheckJobResult.description_zh: 最后状态检查结果。同步前，身份提供方状态检查结果为success时，才能触发同步任务

LogoUrl.description_en: The custom logo URL of the identity provider

LogoUrl.title_en: 身份提供商的自定义 Logo 地址
LogoUrl.title_zh: 身份提供商的自定义 Logo 地址

PeriodicSyncStatus.description_en: The periodic sync status, indicating whether the data differences between EIAM and the identity provider are periodically checked
PeriodicSyncStatus.description_zh: 定时校验状态，是否定时校验EIAM与身份提供方的数据差异
PeriodicSyncStatus.title_en: 定时校验状态，是否定时校验EIAM与身份提供方的数据差异
PeriodicSyncStatus.title_zh: 定时校验状态，是否定时校验EIAM与身份提供方的数据差异

UdPullStatus.description_en:
Whether the inbound sync feature is supported. Valid values:

Disabled: disabled

Enabled: enabled
UdPullStatus.description_zh:
是否支持同步入功能。取值范围：

禁用：disabled

启用：enabled

UdPushStatus.description_en:
Whether the outbound sync feature is enabled. Valid values:

Disabled: disabled

Enabled: enabled
UdPushStatus.description_zh:
是否启用同步出能力，取值范围：

禁用：disabled

启用：enabled

UpdateTime.description_en: The update time, in Unix timestamp format, measured in milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 更新时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
